facts.fact: 24 Heures au Benin reports the eight members of the APDP, named by decree no. 2026-422 of 1 July 2026, were sworn in before the Supreme Court on 6 November 2026 and sent back to their duties.
24 Heures au Benin reports the eight APDP members, named by decree no. 2026-422 of 1 July 2026, were sworn in on 6 November 2026 and began their duties.
